{"command": "
python3 << 'PYEND'
with open('/app/src/sql/parser/parser.rs', 'a') as f:
    f.write('\n    fn parse_statement(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {\n')
    f.write('        match self.peek()? {\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Begin)) => self.parse_begin(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Commit)) => self.parse_commit(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Rollback)) => self.parse_rollback(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Explain)) => self.parse_explain(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Create)) => self.parse_create_table(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Drop)) => self.parse_drop_table(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Delete)) => self.parse_delete(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Insert)) => self.parse_insert(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Update)) => self.parse_update(),\n')
    f.write('            Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Select)) => self.parse_select(),\n')
    f.write('            _ => errinput!("unexpected token: {:?}", self.peek()?),\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_begin(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {\n')
    f.write('        self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Begin));\n')
    f.write('        let read_only = self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Read));\n')
    f.write('        if read_only {\n')
    f.write('            self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Only))?;\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        let as_of = if self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::As)) {\n')
    f.write('            self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Of))?;\n')
    f.write('            self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::System))?;\n')
    f.write('            self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Time))?;\n')
    f.write('            self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Stamp))?;\n')
    f.write('            self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;\n')
    f.write('            let version = self.next()?;\n')
    f.write('            match version {\n')
    f.write('                Token::Number(n) => Some(n.parse()?),\n')
    f.write('                _ => return errinput!("expected version number"),\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('        } else {\n')
    f.write('            None\n')
    f.write('        };\n')
    f.write('        Ok(ast::Statement::Begin { read_only, as_of })\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_commit(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {\n')
    f.write('        self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Commit));\n')
    f.write('        Ok(ast::Statement::Commit)\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_rollback(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {\n')
    f.write('        self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Rollback));\n')
    f.write('        Ok(ast::Statement::Rollback)\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_explain(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {\n')
    f.write('        self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Explain));\n')
    f.write('        let stmt = Box::new(self.parse_statement()?);\n')
    f.write('        Ok(ast::Statement::Explain(stmt))\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_create_table(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Statement> {\n')
    f.write('        self.next_is(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Create));\n')
    f.write('        self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Table))?;\n')
    f.write('        let name = self.next_ident()?;\n')
    f.write('        self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;\n')
    f.write('        let mut columns = Vec::new();\n')
    f.write('        loop {\n')
    f.write('            if self.next_is(Token::CloseParen) {\n')
    f.write('                break;\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            if !columns.is_empty() {\n')
    f.write('                self.expect(Token::Comma)?;\n')
    f.write('                if self.next_is(Token::CloseParen) {\n')
    f.write('                    break;\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            columns.push(self.parse_create_table_column()?);\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        Ok(ast::Statement::CreateTable { name, columns })\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
    f.write('    fn parse_create_table_column(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Column> {\n')
    f.write('        let name = self.next_ident()?;\n')
    f.write('        let datatype = match self.next()? {\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::Boolean) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Bool) => DataType::Boolean,\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::Int) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Integer) => DataType::Integer,\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::Float) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Double) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Real) => DataType::Float,\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::String) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Text) | Token::Keyword(Keyword::Varchar) => DataType::String,\n')
    f.write('            other => return errinput!("expected datatype, got {}", other),\n')
    f.write('        };\n')
    f.write('        let mut primary_key = false;\n')
    f.write('        let mut nullable = None;\n')
    f.write('        let mut default = None;\n')
    f.write('        let mut unique = false;\n')
    f.write('        let mut index = false;\n')
    f.write('        let mut references = None;\n')
    f.write('        loop {\n')
    f.write('            match self.peek()? {\n')
    f.write('                Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Primary)) => {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Key))?;\n')
    f.write('                    primary_key = true;\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Not)) => {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    self.expect(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Null))?;\n')
    f.write('                    nullable = Some(false);\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Null)) => {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    nullable = Some(true);\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Default)) => {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    default = Some(self.parse_expression()?);\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Unique)) => {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    unique = true;\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::Index)) => {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    index = true;\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                Some(Token::Keyword(Keyword::References)) => {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    references = Some(self.next_ident()?);\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('                _ => break,\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('        Ok(ast::Column { name, datatype, primary_key, nullable, default, unique, index, references })\n')
    f.write('    }\n\n')
print('Part 2 done')
PYEND
